result.summary: The screen appears to be a functional UI, but contains one clear layout issue where a restaurant item is cut off at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The restaurant card for the pizza place at the bottom is cut off, making it impossible for the user to see the full content, restaurant name, or relevant metadata.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or scroll behavior of the scroll view to ensure the last item in the list is fully visible and not clipped by the navigation bar.
